name: structifact-validate
description: Run Structifact's own `validate`, `discover`, and `generate` commands against files in this workspace, and review the results, as native VS Code UI.

structifact.cliPath.description: Path to the Structifact CLI executable. You usually don't need to set this: if left unset, the extension checks this workspace's own .venv/ or venv/ folder, then an install of its own it may have bootstrapped for you (offered when none of that is found), before falling back to PATH. Set this explicitly only for an unusual setup (a differently-named or differently-located virtualenv).
